name: Pineapple Juice
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO diets as it contains no significant FODMAPs and may help with vitamin C intake.
preparationTips: Choose 100% pineapple juice without added sugars or high fructose corn syrup
Fresh-squeezed juice is preferable to avoid preservatives
Dilute with water if too acidic for sensitive stomachs
Consume with meals to reduce potential stomach irritation
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Contains bromelain enzyme which may aid digestion
